title: Analysis of RNA-containing compartments by hybridization and proximity labeling in cultured human cells
protocol: Seed HeLa cells the day before fixation/permeabilization to obtain 80%–90% confluent cultures on the day of experiment.
Wash the cells once with 1×PBS (1 mL/well for the 12-well format; 5 mL per 10-cm dish).
Fix with freshly prepared 0.5 mg/mL DSP solution for 30-45 min at 20°C–24°C (1 mL/well or 5 mL/dish).
Wash cells three times with 1×PBS supplemented with 20 mM Tris-HCl, pH 7.5 for 5 minutes each wash.
Permeabilize the cells with 70% ethanol for 1 hour at 20°C–24°C or overnight at 4°C.
Rinse the cells with 2×SSC and 10% formamide for 1-2 minutes.
Dilute digoxigenin-labeled oligonucleotide probes in hybridization buffer.
Cover the cell monolayer with 5 mL of diluted probe for 10-cm dishes.
Incubate samples in a humidified chamber at 37°C overnight.
Wash the cells with 2×SSC and 10% formamide for 30 min at 37°C.
Wash the cells with 1×SSC for 15 min at 20°C–24°C.
Block the cells with 4×SSC, 0.8% BSA, and 0.1 units/μL RNase inhibitor for 30 min at 20°C–24°C.
Incubate the cells with HyPro protein diluted to 2.7 ng/mL in 4×SSC, 0.8% BSA, and 0.1 units/μL RNase inhibitor at 20°C–24°C for 1 h in a humidified chamber.
Wash the cells once with 4×SSC, then once with 4×SSC and 0.1% Triton X-100, followed by another wash with 4×SSC for 10 min each wash at 20°C–24°C.
Incubate the cells in 1×PBS or 1×PBS with 5.4 ng/mL HyPro protein for 5 min at 20°C–24°C.
Add an equal volume of 1×PBS containing 1 mM biotin-phenol and 0.2 mM H2O2, incubate for 1 min at 20°C–24°C.
Aspirate or decant the labeling mixture.
Wash the cells three times with Quencher solution for 30 s to 1 min each wash.
Include no-probe and scrambled-probe controls to ensure signal specificity.
Rinse coverslips with 4×SSC.
Incubate with Alexa Fluor 647 streptavidin (2.5 μg/mL final concentration) in 4×SSC, 0.8% BSA, and 0.1 units/μL RNase inhibitor in a humidified chamber at 20°C–24°C for 1 h in the dark.
Wash with 4×SSC once.
Wash with 4×SSC and 0.1% Triton X-100 once.
Wash with 4×SSC, 10 min, 1 mL each wash.
Rinse with 1×PBS for 1 min.
Counterstain with DAPI (0.5 μg/mL) in 1× PBS for 3 min.
Wash briefly with 1×PBS.
Mount on a clean glass slide with ProLong Gold Antifade mountant avoiding air bubbles.
Cure the mounted sample for 16–24 h at 20°C–24°C in the dark.
Seal glass coverslips with transparent nail polish.
Aspirate the solution from DSP-fixed and EtOH-permeabilized HeLa cells.
Lysate cells directly in the 10-cm dish with 600 μl High-SDS RIPA buffer.
Spread the buffer over the entire dish and incubate on ice for 5 min.
Scrape the lysed material off the plate and incubate for 10 min on ice.
Split the lysate into ≤300-μl aliquots in 1.5-ml microfuge tubes.
Sonicate using a Bioruptor set on “high”, for 7 cycles of 30 s ON/30 s OFF.
Incubate at 37°C for 30 min to reverse DSP crosslinks.
Spin decrosslinked lysate at 15,000×g for 10 minutes at 4°C.
Transfer the supernatant to a new tube.
Wash 60 μL of streptavidin magnetic beads twice with Regular-SDS RIPA buffer.
Resuspend the beads in 3 mL Regular-SDS RIPA buffer.
Combine resuspended beads with approximately 600 μL of lysates.
Incubate the bead-lysate mixture at 20°C–24°C for 2 hours with rotation.
Pellet the beads using a DynaMag™-2 magnet.
Remove the supernatant.
Wash the beads twice with Regular-SDS RIPA buffer.
Wash the beads once with 1 M KCl.
Wash the beads once with 0.1 M Na2CO3.
Wash the beads once with 2 M urea in 10 mM Tris-HCl, pH 8.0.
Wash the beads twice with Regular-SDS RIPA buffer.
Pellet the beads and resuspend them in 15 μL Regular-SDS RIPA buffer supplemented with 1× cOmplete EDTA-free protease inhibitor, 1 mM PMSF, 50 mM DTT, and 5 mM biotin.
Incubate at 37°C for 20 minutes with gentle agitation.
Add 15 μL of 4× LDS sample buffer supplemented with 50 mM DTT to the beads.
Incubate at 70°C for 10 minutes.
Vortex and chill on ice.
Briefly spin down the samples to collect condensation.
Pellet the beads using a DynaMag™-2 magnet and collect the supernatant for immunoblot analysis.
Separate biotinylated proteins by SDS-PAGE.
Transfer them to a nitrocellulose membrane using a preferred electrotransfer method.
Block the membrane with 3% BSA in 1× TBS and 0.1% Tween-20 for 30–60 minutes at 20°C–24°C or overnight (∼16 h) at 4°C.
Incubate with streptavidin-HRP (1:20,000 in 1× TBS and 0.1% Tween-20) for 60 minutes at 20°C–24°C or overnight (∼16 h) at 4°C.
Wash four times with 1×TBS and 0.1% Tween-20 for 5 min at 20°C–24°C.
Visualize the bands using enhanced chemiluminescence.
Pellet the beads.
Remove the supernatant.
Wash the beads three times with 50 mM ammonium bicarbonate.
Resuspend in 45 μL of 50 mM ammonium bicarbonate containing 1.5 μg of Trypsin/Lys-C mix.
Incubate overnight (∼16 h) at 37°C, with rotation.
Add an additional 0.75 μg Trypsin/Lys-C mix in 50 mM ammonium bicarbonate.
Incubate for another 2 h at 37°C, with rotation.
Pellet the beads.
Transfer the supernatant to a fresh tube.
Wash the beads twice with 45 μL of mass-spec grade water.
Combine the washes with the ∼60 μL of supernatant collected at the previous step.
Centrifuge the combined solution at 14,000–16,000×g for 10 min to remove any remaining beads.
Transfer the supernatant to a fresh tube.
Submit the samples for label-free mass spectrometry analysis.
Incubate decrosslinked lysate from step 30 with 20 μL of 20 mg/mL proteinase K at 37°C for 20 min.
Incubate the mixture at 50°C for 60 min.
Add 3 volumes of Trizol LS reagent and mix well.
Purify RNA using a Purelink RNA mini kit as recommended, including the on-column DNAse digestion step.
Elute RNA with 100 μL nuclease-free water.
Set aside 10 μL of the eluate as the input fraction.
Use 20 μL of MyOne streptavidin C1 magnetic beads per 50 μg of total RNA to capture biotinylated species.
Wash the beads three times with a B&W buffer.
Wash the beads once with 0.1 M NaOH and 0.05 M NaCl.
Wash the beads once with 0.1 M NaOH, 0.05 M NaCl, and 0.1% Tween-20.
Wash the beads once with 0.1 M NaCl.
Resuspend the beads in 150 μL of 0.1 M NaCl, 10 mM Tris-HCl, pH 7.5, 1 mM EDTA, and 0.2% Tween-20, containing 0.2 units/μL RNase inhibitor.
Mix the resuspended beads with purified total RNA (90 μL diluted to 150 μL with nuclease-free water) to produce ∼300 μL of the RNA-bead slurry.
Incubate at 4°C for 2 h with rotation.
Collect the beads using a DynaMag™-2 magnet and remove the supernatant.
Wash the beads three times with B&W buffer.
Resuspend in 63 μL nuclease-free water, 33 μL of 3× protease digestion buffer, and 4 μL of proteinase K (20 mg/mL).
Incubate at 50°C for 45 min with agitation.
Add 3 volumes (300 μL) of Trizol LS reagent, mix, and incubate for 5 min.
Add 80 μL chloroform per 400 μL of Trizol mixture, mix vigorously, and incubate at 20°C–24°C for 2–3 min.
Centrifuge the sample for 15 min at 12,000×g at 4°C.
Purify biotinylated RNA from the aqueous phase using an RNA Clean and Concentrator kit.
Elute RNAs in 15 μL of nuclease-free water.
Use 1 μL of the eluate to confirm enrichment of the target RNA of interest by RT-qPCR.
